column1: # Campaign 26 consolidates the source-owned configured ORDER BY LIMIT contract.

column5: ConfiguredLimitWindow directly preserves unsigned offset and count and computes one checked exclusive end while retaining the predecessor identity/hash and ExplainInfo artifact; partition TopN, logical-plan lifecycle, pruning, pushdown, statistics, and runtime LIMIT remain open.

ConfiguredOrderKey preserves source-order direction after supported signed-BIGINT expressions resolve to FullSchema offsets while retaining the predecessor identity/hash artifact; arbitrary expressions, pruning, properties, correlated columns, physical sort, spill, and runtime ordering remain open.

ConfiguredOrderLimitSpec combines a nonempty ordered key list with one checked limit window and retains the predecessor identity/hash artifact; schema lifecycle, partitions, pushdown, statistics, PreferLimitToCop, physical TopN, heap execution, and memory policy remain open.

ConfiguredOrderDirection directly transits ByItems.Desc and ConfiguredOrderKey retains ordered duplicate offsets while preserving the predecessor identity/display artifact; expression objects, hashing, clone, formatting, redaction, memory usage, NULL, coercion, and collation remain open.
